$comment: Fill-in geometry for the Quarterly Progress Report. Shared by the frontend overlay (frontend/src/app/components/QuarterlyProgressReport.tsx) and the backend PDF writer (backend/src/utils/quarterlyReportPdf.js) so the coordinates exist once — the same arrangement as triLayout.json. All values are PDF points; y is measured from the bottom of the page, as pdf-lib draws it. A backend test fails if the writer's own derived geometry stops agreeing with this file. `signature` is derived from the bottom of `narrative`, not from the last aspect row, so the two bands cannot overlap.
